//bankaccount

package javaass;
import java.util.*;
interface payment{
	public void pay(double amt);
}

public class Ecommerce implements payment{
	public static void main(String args[]) {
		Ecommerce e=new Ecommerce();
		e.cardpayment(5777);
		e.upipayment(300);
		e.cashondelivery(400);
	}
	double balance=5660;
	@Override
	public void pay(double amt) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void upipayment(double amt) {
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void  cardpayment(double amt) {
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void cashondelivery(double codamt) {
		balance=balance-codamt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	
}


//E-commerce
package javaass;
import java.util.*;
interface payment{
	public void pay(double amt);
}

public class Ecommerce implements payment{
	public static void main(String args[]) {
		Ecommerce e=new Ecommerce();
		e.cardpayment(5777);
		e.upipayment(300);
		e.cashondelivery(400);
	}
	double balance=5660;
	@Override
	public void pay(double amt) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void upipayment(double amt) {
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void  cardpayment(double amt) {
		balance=balance-amt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	public void cashondelivery(double codamt) {
		balance=balance-codamt;
		System.out.println(balance);
	}
	
}

//String1

package javaass;

public class String1 {
	public static void main(String args[]) {
		String s1="hey";
		String s2="";
		char ch;
		
		for(int i=0;i<s1.length();i++) {
			ch=s1.charAt(i);
			s2=ch+s2;
		}
		System.out.println(s2);
	}
	
}

//Student

package javaass;
import java.util.*;
public class Student {
    public static void main(String args[]){
        ArrayList<String> st=new ArrayList<>();
        st.add("RAM");
        st.add("JAY");
        st.add("DEV");
        st.add("RAJ");
        System.out.println(st);
        System.out.println(Collections.sort(st));
    }
}
